content.short: Wheel of Whales is a luck-based 'Spin-to-Earn' game on TON where players compete for $Whale tokens.
content.description: Wheel of Whales is a popular luck-based social game built as a Telegram Mini App on the TON blockchain. It features a simple and engaging 'Spin-to-Earn' mechanic where players can win $Whale tokens and various other rewards. The game is designed to drive community engagement and provides a fun, low-barrier entry point for users to participate in the TON ecosystem. By combining simple gameplay with crypto incentives, Wheel of Whales has built a significant following, fostering a competitive and rewarding social environment for its players.
